title: Free (and ad free) mobile/web games collection
author: therealmkeeper
selftext:
TL;DR: [https://kurtsfreegames.game-host.org](https://kurtsfreegames.game-host.org)

I've been working on this project for quite a while now, going through a platform shift from monogame to flutter. I'm using AI (claude at this point - early work was in github copilot) to build a collection containing (currently) 35 casual puzzle/mini games.

I started this because the ads constantly interrupting simple games annoyed me. I occasionally add new games to the mix and am open to suggestions, but I'm keeping it casual and friendly.

The app doesn't contain any type of network code, gathers no information from you or your device, stores all game data either on your device (Android) or in your browser (web) and can be played completely offline.

Of course, that means it doesn't look for updates either, and at the moment isn't in the Play store since google themselves collects lots of data from users, so playing via the .APK means it would need to be sideloaded.

The current list of games is:

\*\*Alien Assault\*\*

Hold the line against descending alien formations with a sliding laser cannon that fires automatically. Steer by touch, hide behind crumbling shields, and grab the bonus ship as waves march faster and lower.



\*\*Anagram Tiles\*\*

Tap letter tiles to spell words, then submit, shuffle, or clear. Play Daily Challenge, Free Play Easy, or Free Play Standard using the shared word list.



\*\*Ball Sort\*\*

Sort neon balls so each tube ends with a single color group.



\*\*Binary Tiles\*\*

Slide and merge matching tiles to reach the target value.



\*\*Block Breaker\*\*

Bounce the ball to smash all the bricks and clear each level.



\*\*Block Drop\*\*

Stack falling blocks and clear lines before the board fills up.



\*\*Circuit Fade\*\*

Toggle the glowing circuits and darken the entire grid in as few moves as possible.



\*\*Crate Circuit\*\*

Push cargo crates onto their marked platforms without getting trapped.



\*\*Dice Ledger\*\*

Roll five dice, hold your favorites, and fill your scorecard with winning combinations.



\*\*Fleet Hunter\*\*

Search the seas, locate hidden warships, and sink the enemy fleet in Hunt or Tactical mode.



\*\*Grid Grill\*\*

Assemble neon orders on the light-rail before they fall off the line.



\*\*Klondike Solitaire\*\*

Build four suit piles from Ace to King in the classic card game.



\*\*Letter Link\*\*

Link adjacent letters to form words and score points.



\*\*Mahjong Solitaire\*\*

Match free tile pairs and clear every layered tile.



\*\*Match-3\*\*

Swap adjacent gems to match three or more of the same color.



\*\*Memory Tiles\*\*

Flip cards to find matching pairs before you run out of tries.



\*\*Minefield\*\*

Reveal safe squares and flag mines without triggering any.



\*\*Missile Defense\*\*

Defend your cities from incoming missiles with anti-ballistic fire.



\*\*Moon Lander\*\*

Pilot your lander and touch down gently on the lunar surface.



\*\*Mosaic Cipher\*\*

Decode numbered clues to reveal hidden pixel-art pictures.



\*\*Neon Drift\*\*

Pulse your lightcycle drone through shifting energy gates.



\*\*Open Cell Solitaire\*\*

Use all four open cells wisely to build each suit from Ace to King.



\*\*Parking Panic\*\*

Slide vehicles along their lanes and clear the lot through matching exits.



\*\*Pattern Pulse\*\*

Watch the growing light sequence, then repeat it back perfectly.



\*\*Peg Logic\*\*

Crack the secret color code using feedback from each guess.



\*\*Prism Path\*\*

Turn mirrors and splitters to guide laser beams into every crystal.



\*\*Putt Vector\*\*

Aim, bank your shots, and conquer miniature golf courses in as few strokes as possible.



\*\*Realm Rally\*\*

Claim territory, gather resources, and build cities to out-maneuver rival warlords.



\*\*Relic Rogue\*\*

Delve through dungeon floors, descend stairs, and recover the final relic.



\*\*Stone Strategy\*\*

Sow stones around the board, capture your rival’s pieces, and claim the most stones.



\*\*Sudoku\*\*

Fill the 9x9 grid so every row, column, and box contains 1-9.



\*\*Tower Guard\*\*

Build and upgrade towers along the path to stop every wave before it breaks through.



\*\*Valve Vector\*\*

Rotate pipe sections to connect the flow and power up the entire network.



\*\*Word Guess\*\*

Guess the hidden 5-letter word in six tries.



\*\*Word Search\*\*

Find all the hidden words in the letter grid before time runs out.
